candidateSelection: The single checksum-valid 22-character minikey from the registered frozen Issue27 stream replay and independently matched saved readings, selected by its domain-separated fingerprint. No edited candidates.
queryPolicy: GET every registered address at both providers; 20-second timeout, redirects rejected, no-cache requested. Validate matching address and all five nonnegative safe integer statistics in both chain_stats and mempool_stats. No request failure becomes zero.
addressDerivationPolicy: Two implementations must agree exactly before queries. ASCII minikey SHA256 scalar; public-key compression as declared; P2TR even-Y internal lift and BIP341 TapTweak with no script tree. No HD paths, passwords, arbitrary prose hashes or script guessing.
zeroCriterion: All ten attempts return valid, mutually agreeing all-zero chain and mempool statistics. Scoped to these five mainnet constructions and recorded times.
failurePolicy: Any derivation, control, source/code pin or provider failure/disagreement is inconclusive. Any validated activity triggers private review, not a prize or ownership claim.
controls: Published 30-character minikey and scalar-one five-address controls
Bounded synthetic valid 22-character minikey and invalid checksum/alphabet/length controls
Synthetic 22-character five-address agreement between unchanged Node and Python implementations
Strict frozen Issue27 complete-result and single-22-character-lead summary guard
Synthetic history classifier, public-summary privacy and provider error/no-retry controls
Exactly ten mock attempts and maximum concurrency two
publication: Public protocol and all pinned files must exist in the supplied Git commit; root verifies the commit on GitHub before target derivation or live queries. Candidate, scalar, source locators and address association remain private; safe result is explicitly allowlisted.
limitations: The minikey checksum is eight bits; one pass among 205 distinct shapes is compatible with chance (205/256 is about 0.80 expected passes under uniformly distributed checks).
The saved Issue27 readings use historical investigator choices and OCR conventions; a checksum-valid value does not establish author intent.
Zero history from two explorer operators is not a full-node proof and excludes only the five registered address constructions at check times.
No authenticated prize address is known. Activity would not by itself authenticate a solution, ownership or 20 BTC.
Other wallet scripts, HD derivations, encodings, page rules and future funding remain outside scope.
Python arithmetic is variable-time and memory clearing is best effort; raw target material is never printed or serialized publicly.
